## Description

Home (greeting, "New from Dr…" card, next appointment, To-do from released care plan items), visit summary (Reviewed and shared by Dr…, language tabs, plain-language summary, medicines start/stop, translation disclaimer, Download PDF, Message clinic), records list with statuses (Shared by your doctor, Reviewed by doctor, Ordered, Uploaded by you) and the "appear after your doctor reviews them" notice. 17 px minimum text, 48 px targets.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Only items released by the doctor appear; unreviewed AI drafts and internal notes never appear (test with seeded unreleased items).
- [ ] **AC2.** Translations are shown with "Translated with AI and checked against the English summary your doctor approved…" and only after the doctor approved the source summary.
- [ ] **AC3.** PDF download works and is audited.
- [ ] **AC4.** Meets 17 px minimum text and 48 px targets (automated check) and works offline-tolerant (graceful errors).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
